initial_plan.can_answer: partly: can compare the share of recorded crashes with any reported injury or death, but cannot measure risk per trip or distance traveled
initial_plan.metric: percentage of eligible crashes involving at least one reported injury or death
initial_plan.denominator: crash records with nonmissing number_of_persons_injured and number_of_persons_killed
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes with a usable date and complete injury/death counts, grouped by clock-time period
initial_plan.filters: use complete calendar years only; night is 20:00-05:59, day is 06:00-19:59, missing or invalid times are unknown; exclude records missing either outcome count
initial_plan.years: all complete calendar years present in the file, determined by the data check
initial_plan.grouping: calendar year and time period (night, day, unknown); injury-or-death crash means injured persons > 0 or killed persons > 0

data_check_decisions.coverage: The file spans 2012-07-01 through 2026-06-11. Exclude 2012 and 2026 because their observed date extents are partial; use 2013-2025, whose date extents run Jan 1-Dec 31. No rows have a NULL crash_date.
data_check_decisions.clock_time: Among 2,132,218 dated crash rows in complete years, 0 have NULL, placeholder-string, or invalid crash_time. Keep all rows; 23,787 midnight times are retained as reported and classified as night, while disclosing that the data cannot confirm whether midnight is a default-coded time.
data_check_decisions.outcomes: Within the population, number_of_persons_injured is NULL in 18 rows and number_of_persons_killed is NULL in 36 rows. Exclude any row missing either count from the denominator and event classification; these counts may overlap.
data_check_decisions.row_counts: Annual dated population rows range from 203,742 in 2013 to 85,546 in 2025; these are crash-record denominators, not exposure measures.
data_check_decisions.changes: Restrict to complete date-extent years, exclude rows with either outcome count missing, and retain midnight values as reported in the night group.

final_plan.can_answer: partly: answers whether a larger share of recorded crashes involved injury or death at night, but not whether an individual trip or mile traveled is riskier at night
final_plan.metric: percentage of eligible crash records involving at least one reported injury or death
final_plan.denominator: crash records in each year and time period with nonmissing number_of_persons_injured and number_of_persons_killed
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes with a nonmissing crash date in 2013-2025 and both injury/death counts present
final_plan.filters: exclude partial date-extent years 2012 and 2026 and records missing either outcome count; night is 20:00-05:59, day is 06:00-19:59; missing/invalid times are an unknown group (none observed); retain midnight as reported in night
final_plan.grouping: calendar year and time period (night, day, unknown); event is number_of_persons_injured > 0 or number_of_persons_killed > 0
final_plan.limitations: The file has only partial date extents in 2012 (July 1-Dec 31) and 2026 (Jan 1-June 11), so those years are excluded. Among 2,132,218 dated rows in 2013-2025, injury count is NULL in 18 and death count in 36 (possibly overlapping); those records are excluded because event status cannot be determined. No crash_time values are missing, placeholder, or invalid; 23,787 exact-midnight times are retained in night, although possible default coding cannot be verified. Final eligible annual crash denominators range from 203,742 in 2013 to 85,543 in 2025, and no trip/traffic/distance exposure denominator is available, so this is severity conditional on a recorded crash, not road-user risk.
